audit.why: Early is a poke lane you survive, level 3 is his kill window, 4-5 swing back to you, and the late game is a split-push question. The existing early/mid/late split matches that; only the mechanism inside it was wrong.
audit.corrected: No difficulty-shape change proposed; the fixes are mechanical (see point 4).

audit.why: The chart reads Sion, Sion, Ryze, Sion, Skill, Ryze, Sion and each whys[] entry argues for its own row — level 3 to Ryze on the root combo, 4-5 to you once Rune Prison is down, level 6 even on Realm Warp, first item to Ryze on burst, two-plus to you on HP. Nothing contradicts the 55.14% win rate.
audit.corrected: Chart left intact. No full-layer entry exists, so there are no phases[].side rows to pair.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every mention of Rune Prison treats it as a root. It is not: Riot's text says it damages and slows, and only roots if the target already has Flux on them.
audit.why: That prerequisite is the whole matchup. Spell Flux is a 615-range orb; dodge it, or stand outside 615, and his W can only slow you — which is a trade you survive rather than the lockdown the page describes.
audit.corrected: Stated the Flux prerequisite in whys[2], spikes[1].text, wants.foe[0], wants.you[1], early and mid, with the 615 range and Rune Prison's 11s rank-1 cooldown.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ryze.json W and E text and ranges

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown number anywhere for the ability the page calls his win condition.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1 while Overload is 5s and reset by his other casts — so the punishable window is the W, not the poke.
audit.corrected: Added the 11s figure to wants.you[1] and mid.

edits.before: Full kit Ryze lands Rune Prison and chains Q-E-W-Q into you before your knockup can land — this is his cleanest kill window all lane.
edits.after: At 3 he can root — but only through Spell Flux; Rune Prison on a clean target just slows. Flux into root into Overload is his cleanest kill window all lane.

edits.before: Ryze's Q-E-W root combo comes fully online and can lock you in place for his entire damage rotation before you land a stun.
edits.after: His Spell Flux into Rune Prison lock comes online — but with no Flux on you that W only slows, so dodging the 615-range orb is the whole fight.

edits.before: Root you with Rune Prison and chain his entire Q-E-Q rotation while you cannot respond
edits.after: Tag you with Spell Flux so Rune Prison roots instead of slowing, then chain Overload twice

edits.before: Bait his W Rune Prison root into your W-shield, then run the full Q-E knockup-shred combo while it is on cooldown
edits.after: Sidestep Spell Flux so Rune Prison can only slow you, then run the full Q-E knockup-shred inside its 11s cooldown

edits.before: At level 1 Ryze can Q-E you freely and you have no real answer — farm at max Q range and do not try to charge into his face. The moment your W comes online at level 2, his poke math changes: you pop W before his Q lands and suddenly he is spending 80 mana to deal 40 health to a shield. At level 3 he is dangerous — his Rune Prison root is his win condition, locking you in place long enough for his full Q-E-W-Q rotation to chunk you. Play the charge telegraph behind the wave and only commit when you see the root whiff or come off cooldown.
edits.after: At level 1 Overload reaches 1000 units and you have no answer at that range — farm on the back of the wave and do not walk into his face. The moment your W comes online at level 2, his poke math changes: you pop Soul Furnace before his Q lands and he is spending mana to damage a shield. At level 3 he is dangerous, but only through Spell Flux: that orb is 615 range, and without it on you Rune Prison slows instead of rooting. Hold the charge telegraph behind the wave and commit when the Flux whiffs or the W goes down.

edits.before: From 4 onward your job is to force him to either root you (and eat the charged Q stun after the root expires) or back off the wave and give up farm. At level 6 his Realm Warp is a wildcard — it lets him escape your Unstoppable Onslaught by warping allies in top, turning your R-engage into a 1v2. Coordinate with your jungler before you burn R on him. When the Rune Prison is down, you step up, charge Q in the fog or behind a minion angle, E-slow, and chain the full stun: that full pattern wins the trade cleanly even with his poke lead.
edits.after: From 4 onward your job is to force him to either spend Spell Flux and Rune Prison on you — and eat the charged Q once they expire — or back off the wave and give up farm. At level 6 Realm Warp is a wildcard: it lets him answer Unstoppable Onslaught by warping allies top, turning your engage into a 1v2, so talk to your jungler before you burn R. Inside the 11 seconds his W is down you step up, charge Q from fog or a minion angle, E-slow and chain the stun: that pattern wins the trade even through his poke lead.
